name: Litmus test: one behaviour per line (paste the heads-up first)

lines.text: Hi everyone, thanks for coming, give me a second here.
I run a community called OpenSverige.
We are seven hundred builders right now.
And the best part, you can join without a login. No account, no password.
Every morning my inbox explodes. A thousand notifications before coffee.
And I just sit there and scroll, and scroll, and I answer nothing.
Honestly, eighty percent of those messages are from bots.
So I had this idea. Imagine a room. And in that room
I put a robot that says no to everything. I am going to be a millionaire.
The first week was totally chaotic. Nobody knew who did what.
There are three things I learned.
Ship fast, share everything, and never wait for permission.
Speed matters. Big companies need six months. We did it in a weekend.
Anyway, completely different thing, my dog. He sleeps on my keyboard all day.
And then the investor looked at me and said nothing. He just blinked.
Sweden is one of the most digital countries in the world.
